<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="nodon-dragonkin" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Nodon Dragonkin</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are 4 Nodon dragonkin variants that can be killed for slayer: Nodon engineers, artificers, hunters, and guards. The Nodon dragonkin task can be assigned by Morvran or Laniakea and requires level 92 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Additionally, players can kill Kerapac </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1" alt="kerapac" title="kerapac" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in Normal Mode or Hard Mode, since the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buffs (but not </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="Tuskas" title="Tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) apply to the boss.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Currently there are only methods detailed for Nodon guards and artificers. If you have a different method for Nodon hunters or engineers, please make a post in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><strong><nowiki>Note</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Dragon cluster tasks from Laniakea apply </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="Tuskas" title="Tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buffs to Slayer monsters at Nodon front but not </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1" alt="kerapac" title="kerapac" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. This also applies for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayer" title="dragonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayerperk" title="dragonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Dragonbane weaponry.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Nodon dragonkin cannon upgrade kits </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271674785842.png?v=1" alt="coilupgradekit" title="coilupgradekit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271733481493.png?v=1" alt="kineticcycloneupgradekit" title="kineticcycloneupgradekit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271788023838.png?v=1" alt="cannonupgradekit" title="cannonupgradekit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Drop rates of 1/2000 each from guards, artificers and hunters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rate are 3/2560 each from Nodon engineers and 5/64 each from Elite versions (Nodon enforcers).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Option 1: Teleport to the Senntisten cathedral using the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870326852361789501.png?v=1" alt="pontifexshadowring" title="pontifexshadowring" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and run to your destination </nowiki><strong><nowiki>(Fastest for Nodon Guards)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Option 2: Enter a War's Retreat/Max Guild </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1" alt="kerapac" title="kerapac" kind="icon" /><nowiki> portal and run to the location from there </nowiki><strong><nowiki>(Fastest for Nodon Artificers)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/V3U9dAn.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/gUzgqdg.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-afk-magic"><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><h2 id="disclaimer"><nowiki>⚠️ Disclaimer</nowiki></h2><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>This method may not work after the combat changes made in Q1 of 2026</nowiki></strong></p><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Know of a newer method/rotation? Got a video? Share it in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>!</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="Affliction" title="Affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/547603714681339915.png?v=1" alt="superprayerrenewal" title="superprayerrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Autocast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is unknown if the method works with Ganodermic armour </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947807754960896.png?v=1" alt="ganohelm" title="ganohelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947805611655208.png?v=1" alt="ganobody" title="ganobody" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947803673903204.png?v=1" alt="ganolegs" title="ganolegs" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1003947801836789830.png?v=1" alt="ganoboots" title="ganoboots" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. If you try the method with this gear, please provide a vod in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#suggestions</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-afk-magic-legacy"><nowiki>Method: AFK Magic (Legacy)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ By standing 1 tile behind the position used in the image, one can safespot the artificers. Although this is considerably less AFK as you cannot use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1084799717726228530.png?v=1" alt="autoretaliate" title="autoretaliate" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, it is useful if the player is undergeared.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure you are doing the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Classic_Modes <nowiki>Legacy combat</nowiki>]<nowiki> is active.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> points with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975765831248130079.png?v=1" alt="demonhornnecklace" title="demonhornnecklace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/929773040273862656.png?v=1" alt="holyscarab" title="holyscarab" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Autocast </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /></p>
